items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who was in that band? Kinkins Band or Jenkins? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Who was in that band? Jenkins. Jenkins. Jenkins.

ctx.x: Who was in that band? Kinkins Band or Jenkins?
Who was in that band? Jenkins. Jenkins. Jenkins.
He was talking about the Kid Band with Joe Oliver.
